name: fred_30yr_mortgage
description:
The 30-year fixed mortgage average rate (Freddie Mac survey) from FRED, the St. Louis Fed's economic database: series MORTGAGE30US (percent, weekly).
Returns {"series": "MORTGAGE30US", "data": <FRED observations response>}; data.observations = [{date (YYYY-MM-DD), value (a string, "." if missing), realtime_start, realtime_end}], newest first; data is {"error": ...} if the call fails.
Inputs (* required): limit (integer, number of newest observations; default 30).
Related: fred_10yr_treasury, fred_housing_starts, fred_new_home_sales.
Example: {"limit": 12}

limit.description: Number of most recent observations to return (newest first)
